Significant events during the period April–June
June
Conditional approval from NGM:

On 18 June 2026, Nordic Growth Market NGM AB granted conditional approval for the Company's continued listing following the new listing review prompted by the business combination with Medicortex Finland Oyj. The approval was conditional on the acquisition being completed and on no significant new information emerging that would affect the Company's ability to meet the listing requirements.
Acquisition completed:

On 29 June 2026, the Swedish Companies Registration Office (Bolagsverket) registered the directed set-off issue of 19,910,159 class B shares to the sellers of Medicortex. This completed the acquisition of 89.9 percent of the shares in Medicortex Finland Oyj (the completion date).
All conditions fulfilled, name change and new CEO:

On 30 June 2026, all conditions in NGM's approval were fulfilled. The Company changed its name to Medicortex International AB (publ) and Dr Adrian Harel took office as CEO of the combined Group. An Information Memorandum regarding the Group was published the same day.
Significant events after the end of the period
July
New ticker and observation status removed:

As of 1 July 2026, the share is traded under the new ticker MEDFIN B (formerly NOSIUM B); the ISIN code SE0023112065 is unchanged. On the same day, NGM decided to remove the observation status the Company had held since June 2025.
CEO comment

“It is with great pride and confidence in the future that we step into the next phase for the Company. Since 1 July 2026, Medicortex International AB (publ) has been traded under the new ticker MEDFIN B (replacing NOSIUM B) — a change that marks our sharpened focus going forward.”
Adrian Harel, CEO, Medicortex International AB (publ)
The above is an excerpt from the CEO's comment, which appears in full on page 5 of the attached report.

About Medicortex International

Medicortex International AB (publ) is the parent company of Medicortex Finland Oyj, a Finnish medical technology company developing non-invasive diagnostic tests for traumatic brain injury. The company has received 8.4 million EUR in funding, including three grants from the U.S. Department of Defense, and holds a strong patent portfolio with 10 patents. The global market for TBI diagnostics is expected to reach 3.3 billion USD by 2029. More information is available at medicortex.fi and medicortex.eu
